notes.title: Game icon suggestions - Let's vote!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559639/a74b2990ac55ff277d9ac0adbe886bb0097431b6.png[/img]🃏 Choose a solution for Ellentis!

Your opinion is very important to us! We are working on the final game icon and we have 5 ideas - each of them is one of the deck reverses in the game. The last one is the current icon for comparison - number 6.

💡 Which one best reflects the atmosphere of Ellentis?
I want the icon to be retained on Steam, reflect the character of the game and be readable even on a small device.

📢 Voting: Write in the comment the number that You feel fits the best! You can also add your comments - what works and what would you change?

Let the best icon win!

Warm greetings to everyone and hear you soon. ; )
